title_patterns_that_work: Using parentheses for emphasis like '(The Truth)' or '(I Checked The Data)'
Direct investigation formats such as 'Is [Brand] Legit or a Ticket Scam?'
Short-form videos (#Shorts) targeting popular consumer apps and e-commerce platforms
title_patterns_to_avoid: Overly dry corporate investigations without a clear consumer stakes angle
Long-form deep dives without an immediate high-interest hook in the first few words
notes: Shorts significantly outperform long-form content on average, especially when dealing with high-intent consumer scam checks and popular shopping platforms (e.g., DHgate, Cashify, StubHub).
